rounds.response:
Q3 Release – Planning Summary (Draft)

Key objectives
- Deliver Q3 feature set: Billing Dashboard v1, API Export v2, and usage-based billing backend as specified in the requirements doc.
- Complete backend data migration and support external payments provider integration to enable live billing.
- Stabilize core flows to meet agreed performance and compliance constraints for customer rollout.

Scope boundaries (in-scope / out-of-scope)
- In-scope: Billing Dashboard UI v1, API Export v2 endpoints, backend billing calculations, DB schema migration, payments provider integration, deployment/runbook updates.
- Out-of-scope: Full UI redesign, mobile app changes, advanced analytics, promotional pricing engine (deferred to later release).

Key dependencies
- Payments provider: final integration API and sandbox access (timeline dependency).
- Database migration support (DB team availability and maintenance window).
- Analytics/monitoring team for production metrics and SLO dashboards.
- Legal/compliance sign-off for updated data retention/encryption controls.

Non-functional requirements that materially affect scope/dependencies
- Target API 95th-percentile latency ≤250ms for export endpoints (may require infra changes).
- 99.9% availability target during business hours; plan for migration rollback window.
- Data-at-rest encryption and GDPR export capability required before public rollout (affects timeline with Legal/Compliance).
- Expected data volume and retention policy driving storage and migration approach.

Open engineering questions (need answers or decisions)
- Confirm payments provider cutover date and whether tokenization method is final.
- Are DB schema changes allowed in-place or must use shadow-table migration approach?
- Expected peak QPS and data volume for sizing; confirm acceptable maintenance window for migration.
- Approve required SLOs/alert thresholds and on-call coverage for rollout weekend.
- Any constraints on rollout region order or feature flag gating for partial launch?

Notes/next steps
- Engineering to add owners, estimates, and detailed acceptance criteria; please flag missing requirements or clarify any item above before I transfer this to the planning page.
